steps.cmd: lua local i=1; for _,kind in {'office','hotel','warehouse','office'} do for _,b in state.city.buildings do if b.kind==kind and (i<4 or b.x>0) then world.place(state.fleet.players[i].body,b.door+vector.create(0,.85,3)); i+=1; break end end end

lua local n=0; for _,p in state.fleet.players do if p.building then n+=1 end end; assert(n==4); local pieces=0; for _,ids in state.interiors.active do pieces+=#ids end; return {buildings=#state.city.buildings,pieces=pieces}
